description: A utility helper class for working with JsonObject instances, providing a generic method to retrieve typed values with default handling and type safety.

classes.name: JsonHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to simplify safe extraction of values from JsonObject instances, including default values and type casting.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value of specified type from a JsonObject by key, with support for default value if the key is absent or type mismatch occurs.
